title: Meetily for Government - Secure AI Meeting Assistant for Public Sector

children.text: Secure Government Meeting Documentation with Complete Data Sovereignty

Meetily is the privacy-first meeting transcription app for public-sector teams that need full data sovereignty. The architecture supports FISMA controls by design and aligns with the NIST 800-53 control families that underpin FedRAMP. No meeting bots join the call, and it runs inside your own accredited or air-gapped environment, with transcription processed 100% locally on the agency device.

Secure, sovereign meeting documentation for public-sector teams. Meetily is not FedRAMP-authorized; FedRAMP/FISMA authorization is a customer or agency designation for a specific deployment. Meetily provides the architecture - 100% local transcription that runs inside your own accredited environment.
FedRAMP-ready architecture that aligns with the NIST 800-53 control families underpinning FISMA. Runs inside your own accredited or air-gapped environment, with transcription processed 100% locally.

Local transcripts and summaries your agency can retain as records, with advanced export formats for FOIA-ready record-keeping inside your own systems. Speaker identification attributes statements to each participant across hearings and public meetings.
Meeting audio never leaves your infrastructure - no meeting bots, no vendor cloud for transcription. Supports FISMA controls by design within your accredited environment.

children.a: No. Meetily is not FedRAMP-authorized and holds no FISMA certification. Authorization is a customer or agency designation for a specific deployment, not a vendor badge. What Meetily provides is a FedRAMP-ready architecture that supports FISMA controls by design and aligns with the NIST 800-53 control families underpinning those programs - with on-device, fully local transcription. Your agency runs and accredits the deployment inside its own environment.

children.q: How does Meetily help protect sensitive information?
children.a: Meetily runs inside your own accredited or air-gapped environment. Transcription happens 100% locally on the agency device, so meeting audio never leaves your infrastructure. There is no meeting bot joining the call. Access controls, audit logging, and classification handling remain the responsibility of your accredited environment.

Meetily produces local transcripts and summaries that your agency can retain as records. Recordings and transcripts are saved locally to the agency device, and advanced export formats support FOIA-ready record-keeping inside your own systems.
Data sovereignty is maintained through local processing - transcription happens on your own infrastructure, not on external servers. This gives your agency full control over government meeting data.

children.q: How does Meetily align with government security requirements?
children.a: Meetily's architecture aligns with the NIST 800-53 control families that underpin FedRAMP and FISMA, and supports FISMA controls by design. Recordings stay on the agency device, transcription runs entirely on-device, and self-hosted or air-gapped deployment keeps data inside your environment. Meetily is not FedRAMP-authorized; authorization is a designation your agency obtains for its specific deployment.
